shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline | head

cat index.html; echo ---; find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}'; echo ---; cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -o "variant?: [^;]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -3; grep -rho "'[a-z-]*'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -o "view?: [^;]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; grep -o "size?: [^;]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "TEXT_VARIANTS" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/constants.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "ButtonView\|ButtonSize" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -4; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40
